description: Just me trying to win for the fourth time.
summary:
This project studies terrestrial analogs and demonstrates the fact that the current preparation and simulation system for space missions can definitely do with some upgrades.
It proposes a new model of analog testing called 'Not Anymore' and an Analog Similarity calculator.
details:
My project analyses the current system of analog research and samples some relations between landing sites and analogs before coming to a decisive solution:

Not Anymore...

The true solution.

This is a three-step model that allows scientists to easily simulate celestial environments and classify the analogs in use.

I also created a prototype for an analog similarity calculator that easily allows grading analog quality.

I used Google Slides, Google Sheets and Google Earth Pro to develop my project.

I think the creative importance of the project is that it doesn't directly resort to new methods, it studies and samples existing methods in detail.
